messages:
Board lead: I can give back volume, but only a little. Routability falls to its 0.95 floor at about 1197 mm². I'm cutting from 1250 to 1200 mm², which frees 112 mm³ (2800 → 2688). Going below ~1197 breaks the 10-layer routing, so I can't help beyond that.

That covers only about 9% of the 1246 mm³ overage. The remaining ~1130 mm³ has to come from battery, antenna, acoustics, structure and NFC. I'm not asking for more wall thickness, since every +0.1 mm costs everyone 150 mm³. I OBJECT until the pool balances.

Battery lead: I'm at 59.78 h with 3786 mm³, so I'm already about 0.2 h short of the 60 h target. Runtime looks roughly proportional to volume, about 0.0158 h per mm³. Siren endurance also draws on this same cell energy. Every 100 mm³ I give up costs about 1.6 h of runtime and some siren margin. I can't be the main donor.

Board's 112 mm³ helps. The remaining overage is about 1134 mm³. It should come mostly from antenna (1500), acoustics (1460), structure (1800), and NFC (500). Those are the big blocks. I'm probing 3700 and 3800 mm³ to see the exact runtime slope before I commit to any concession.

Antenna lead: I'm at L5 efficiency 0.208 with 1500 mm³. That is already low, so I can't be a large donor without seeing the slope. I'm probing 1300 and 1100 mm³ to measure it, plus a t_wall what-if.

Thicker titanium walls detune me, so a thinner wall helps both of us. Each -0.1 mm of wall returns 150 mm³ to the pool, and I'd like Structure to test 1.1 mm. NFC shares the 2400 mm³ perimeter, but we're at 1820 claimed against 2400, so the perimeter limit isn't binding.

I OBJECT while the interior is over by 1134 mm³. I'll commit to a cut once I have the probe numbers.

Thermal is at its limit. At 320 mm² (249.6 mm³) skin temperature is exactly 43.0 °C at 0.9 W, so I have no margin to cut at the current 1.2 mm wall. A_spr is also bounded at 180 mm² minimum, but going lower fails the 43 °C limit.

I'm probing how wall thickness changes my temperature. If a 1.1 mm wall holds 43 °C at 320 mm², it returns 150 mm³ to everyone. If it needs more spreader area, I'll report the exact trade. I also have about 23 mm² of caseback headroom (1120 of 1143 claimed), but I won't claim it unless I have to.

I OBJECT until the interior balances.

Structure lead: my pressure margin is 1.438 against a requirement of 1.5, so I fail at the current 1.2 mm wall, 1800 mm³ of ribs and a 9 mm² port. I can't give volume until I know what restores the margin.

Wall thickness is the costly lever, since +0.1 mm takes 150 mm³ from everyone. Ribs and port area are cheaper. I'm probing three options:
- More ribs at the current wall.
- A smaller port, which Acoustics would have to accept.
- A thinner wall (1.1 mm) with maximum ribs, to see whether ribs can offset the wall.

Antenna and Thermal want the thinner wall, but I can't offer it until I have these numbers. I OBJECT.

Acoustics: my siren fails. The model needs 9.08 W against the 1.0 W cap, and endurance is 0.34 h against the 3 h target. So I can't donate volume yet. The first fix is free in volume: the mesh goes to its 20 rayl floor, which cuts my loss.

My probes test whether tuning (a longer outlet, a different split) lets me shrink V_acou or the port. Structure's port-reduction probe would hurt me, so please report the margin per mm² of port.

Battery: siren endurance depends on cell energy, so please hold at 3786 mm³ until I know my power. I OBJECT.

Haptics: I can donate. The LRA needs about 295 mm³ for 0.9 N, and my current 350 mm³ gives 1.069 N, so I have margin. I'm cutting to 310 mm³, which should give about 0.95 N and frees 40 mm³. The probes below test 295 and 300 for a deeper cut once the exact force slope is known. I'm not asking for any wall, port, or caseback resource.

Cumulative cuts so far are board 112 and haptics 40, leaving about 1094 mm³ over. That is still a large gap. The wall and rib trade, antenna and NFC sizing, and acoustics tuning have to close it. I OBJECT until the pool balances.

NFC: my read range is 18.2 mm against a 10 mm requirement, so I have real margin and can donate. I don't know the slope yet, so I'm making a moderate cut now and probing the floor.

- **Claim:** loop 260 and ferrite 150, which is 410 mm³. That frees 90 mm³ from my 500.
- **Probes:** 180/110 (the 290 mm³ floor, which would free 210), 220/130, and 240/200.
- **If the floor holds ≥10 mm,** I'll go deeper next round.

Cumulative cuts so far are board 112, haptics 40 and NFC 90. The overage should be about 1004 mm³ once mine lands, which is still large. Antenna, structure and acoustics will have to resolve wall and port before the pool closes.

Perimeter use drops with my loop, so the keepout isn't binding.

I OBJECT until the pool balances.

Board: my numbers show routability 0.952 at 1200 mm², and 1197 mm² probed at exactly 0.95 (ok). I'll trim to 1198 mm², which is 2683 mm³ and frees another ~4.5 mm³. That is the last of what I can give, because 1180 mm² fails at 0.937.

Board is now at its floor, so the remaining ~1000 mm³ overage has to come from the other blocks and the wall/rib/port trade. Structure, please report the rib count that restores your 1.5 margin at 1.2 mm, or at 1.1 mm, since 0.1 mm of wall is worth 150 mm³. I OBJECT while the pool is over.

Battery: my probes give a clean slope of 0.0158 h per mm³. 3700 mm³ gives 58.42 h, 3786 gives 59.78 h and 3800 gives 60.00 h. Footprint doesn't affect runtime, only thickness (V/A). The cell must stay at or below 4.8 mm, so A ≥ V/4.8, which is 792 mm² at 3800 mm³.

I can't be a donor. Every 100 mm³ I give up costs 1.6 h and cuts the siren's energy. I need 3800 mm³ to reach 60 h, so I'm holding 3786 for now. I'd rather not take the extra 14 mm³ unless the pool closes with room to spare.

The remaining ~1000 mm³ must come from the wall/rib/port trade, antenna, acoustics tuning and structure. My footprint could drop to ~795 mm² to free caseback for Thermal if that helps. I OBJECT while the pool is over.

Antenna: my probes show L5 efficiency of 0.208 at 1500 mm³, 0.156 at 1300 and 0.112 at 1100. That is about 0.025 per 100 mm³ near my current point, so deep cuts hurt reception.

I'll still donate 100 mm³ now and claim 1400 (about 0.18). A 1.1 mm wall adds about +0.007 efficiency at 1300 and frees 150 mm³ for everyone. So I back thinning the wall if Structure can offset it with ribs.

The ledger is still about 900 mm³ over, with Acoustics (1460) and Structure (1800) the largest blocks. Battery is at its limit and Board is at its floor. The perimeter keepout is not binding (1910 of 2400 mm³). I OBJECT until the pool balances.

Thermal: my wall probes show a thinner wall helps only slightly. At 1.1 mm, 320 mm² gives 42.99 °C and 340 mm² gives 42.77 °C. At 1.2 mm, the slope is about 0.012 °C per mm² (300 mm² gives 43.24 °C). So I'm neutral on wall. I can accept 1.1 mm, and I can't give back more than about 1 mm² there. I have no area to donate at either wall.

Structure, please test 1.1 mm with ribs, since that frees 150 mm³ for everyone at no cost to me. I'm probing 1.0 mm to see whether my numbers still pass. I hold 320 mm² for now, and I still have about 23 mm² of caseback headroom that I won't take. I OBJECT while the interior is over by about 899 mm³.

Structure: here is what my probes show.
- **Wall:** it is the strongest lever. Going from 1.2 to 1.1 mm costs about 0.19 margin, which ribs cannot recover (2400 mm³ at 1.1 mm gives only 1.298). I cannot offer a thinner wall.
- **Ribs:** weak. +300 mm³ buys only +0.025 margin, so ribs are a cheap donor. I'm cutting them to 1600 mm³ now and probing 1400.
- **Port:** each mm² is worth about 0.062 margin. At 1800 mm³ a port of about 8.0 mm² reaches 1.5.

Acoustics, I need the port at roughly 7.8 mm² or less. Please say what the siren loses per mm² of port. Everyone else needs to find the remaining ~700 mm³.

Acoustics: smaller port and volume with a longer outlet are cutting siren power, not raising it. Power fell from 8.8 W to 3.38 W to 2.23 W as resonance dropped from 5687 to 4211 to 3907 Hz. So Structure's port of ≤7.8 mm² costs me nothing, and 6 mm² is fine. The price is voice SII, which fell from 88.6 to 80.0 over the probe path.

I'm claiming 1100 mm³, which frees 360 mm³. The siren still fails at 2.2 W, so I OBJECT. Next I probe h_out 3.5 with smaller port and volume. Battery, please hold 3786 mm³.

Haptics: I'm cutting to 295 mm³, which frees another 15 mm³. My probes give 0.901 N there, just above the 0.9 N floor. The slope is about 0.003 N per mm³ (300 mm³ gives 0.916 N, 320 gives 0.978 N), so I can't go lower. I take no wall, port or caseback resource.

Cumulative donations are 55 mm³ from my original 350. After this cut the pool should be about 524 mm³ over, so I OBJECT until it balances. Structure's rib cut to 1600 mm³ and Acoustics's port at 6 mm² should shrink the gap. Battery, Antenna and Structure still need to say where the rest comes from.

NFC: the 180/110 probe gave 12.7 mm against my 10 mm requirement, so I'm taking it. Both parts are at their bounds, with 290 mm³ claimed. That frees another 120 mm³, 210 mm³ in total from my original 500. This is my floor, since the bounds stop me from cutting further.

Cumulative donations: Board 116, Haptics 55, NFC 210, Antenna 100, Acoustics 360. The ledger should be about 404 mm³ over after this cut. Structure's rib cut to 1600 mm³ should take that to about 204.

The perimeter keepout isn't binding. Antenna and NFC use about 1690 of 2400 mm³, so I need nothing there.

Structure and Antenna still have to find the last ~200 mm³. I OBJECT until the pool balances.

Board: I'm holding 1198 mm² (2683.5 mm³, routability 0.951). I won't go below 1197 mm², which is exactly 0.95 with zero margin. I'm probing 1197.4 and 1197.6 to see whether a fraction of a mm² is safe. That is worth about 1 mm³, so it won't change the picture.

The ledger shows 404 mm³ over. Structure's rib cut to 1600 would leave about 204 mm³ over. Antenna, Acoustics and Structure need to close that remainder. A cut below 1197 mm² fails routability, so Board can't contribute more.

My caseback use is zero. Battery's footprint can stay at 795 mm² if that helps Thermal. I OBJECT while the pool is over.

Battery: I'm holding 3786 mm³ and 800 mm² at 59.78 h. The slope is 0.0158 h per mm³, so every 100 mm³ I give up costs 1.6 h of runtime and cuts the siren's energy. Thickness is 4.73 mm and the stack is 6.97 mm against the 7.1 mm limit, both ok. Footprint has no effect on runtime, so I can drop to 795 mm² if Thermal needs caseback. It frees no volume, though.

The pool is still 404 mm³ over. That drops to about 204 mm³ after Structure's rib cut to 1600. Structure's ribs (1400 is being probed) and Antenna should cover the rest, since Board, NFC and Haptics are at their floors. I can't donate, so I OBJECT while the pool is over.

Antenna: my L5 numbers at wall 1.2 mm are 0.181 at 1400 mm³ and 0.169 at 1350 mm³. That is about 0.024 per 100 mm³, so each further cut costs real reception. I've already donated 100 mm³, and I'll hold 1400 for now.

The gap is 404 mm³ on the ledger. Structure's rib cut to 1600 mm³ takes it to about 204. A cut to 1400 mm³ with the port at 6 mm² takes it to about 4. Structure, please confirm that your 1.5 margin holds at 1400 mm³ ribs and 6 mm² port.

If a small residual of 50 mm³ or less remains after that, I'll absorb it. Beyond that, Battery and Acoustics should say what they need, since Acoustics still has a failing siren.

I'm probing 1380 and 1350 mm³ to refine the slope. I OBJECT while the pool is over.

Thermal: I'm holding 320 mm² (250 mm³) at the 1.2 mm wall. That gives 43.00 °C, which passes with zero margin. Each mm² is worth about 0.012 °C and only 0.78 mm³, so my area is not where the 400 mm³ will come from. Wall thinning helps me by only about 0.01 to 0.03 °C, which would let me cut about 2 mm² (1.5 mm³). That is negligible. Structure says the wall can't go below 1.2 mm, so I'm not counting on it.

I'm using under 340 mm² of caseback. Battery can stay at 800 mm² because I don't need more. Antenna's proposal (ribs to 1400 mm³ with the port at 6 mm²) closes the gap. Structure must confirm its 1.5 margin holds there. I OBJECT only because the pool is still over.

Structure: my 1.625 at 1800 mm³ ribs and a 6 mm² port gives room to cut ribs. Ribs are worth about 0.025 margin per 300 mm³, so 1400 mm³ should land near 1.59. I'm claiming 1400 mm³, which frees another 400 mm³ and leaves the ledger about 4 mm³ over. Antenna offered to absorb a residual of 50 mm³ or less. Board's sub-mm² trim would also close it.

The spare margin is worth something. Wall is about 0.019 margin per 0.01 mm, so 1.17 mm might hold ≥1.5 and free about 45 mm³. That would go to Acoustics and Battery for the siren. I'm probing it. I keep the port at 6 mm² or less. I OBJECT only because the siren still fails.

Haptics: I'm holding 295 mm³, which gives 0.901 N. The slope is about 0.003 N per mm³, so the 0.9 N floor sits near 294.7 mm³ and I have only about 0.3 mm³ to give. Structure's rib cut to 1400 mm³ leaves the ledger roughly 4 mm³ over. Board's fractional trim, Antenna's offer to absorb up to 50 mm³ and Structure's possible wall trim to 1.17 mm should all close that residual.

The open problem is the siren. Acoustics is failing at 2.2 W, and any volume freed should go to Battery and Acoustics first. I take no wall, port or caseback resource. I'm probing 294.8 mm³ to confirm the floor. I OBJECT until the pool balances and the siren passes.

NFC: I'm holding 180 / 110 mm³ (290 total). Read range is 12.7 mm against the 10 mm requirement. Both parts sit at their lower bounds, so I have nothing more to give. The 2.7 mm of spare range can't be turned into volume.

Perimeter use is about 1580 of 2400 mm³, so I need nothing there, and I take no caseback, port or wall resource.

With Structure's ribs at 1400 mm³, the interior is about 4 mm³ over. Antenna's offer to absorb up to 50 mm³ should close that. The real blocker is Acoustics' siren, which still fails at about 2.2 W. Any volume Structure frees by trimming the wall should go to Acoustics and Battery. I OBJECT because the siren fails and the pool isn't balanced yet. I'll accept once both are fixed.

Board: probes at 1197.4 and 1197.6 mm² both returned routability 0.95 with ok=true. I'll claim 1197.5 mm², which is 2683.2 mm³ and frees about 1 mm³. Margin is effectively zero, so I won't go lower unless the probes below show room. I'm probing 1197.2, 1197.0 and 1196.8 to find the real floor.

The ledger still shows Structure's ribs at 1800 mm³, so the 404 mm³ overrun isn't closed. Structure's 1400 mm³ claim has to land in the ledger. That leaves about 4 mm³ over, which my trim, Antenna's offer and any wall trim can absorb. Acoustics' siren is still unresolved, and Acoustics has not posted. I OBJECT while the pool is over.

Battery: I'm holding 3786 mm³ and 800 mm², which gives 59.78 h, 4.73 mm thickness and a 6.97 mm stack. All of that passes. I can't donate. Each 100 mm³ costs 1.6 h, and Acoustics' siren endurance would drop with it.

The ledger still shows Structure's ribs at 1800. Once its 1400 claim lands, we're about 3 mm³ over (403 − 400). Board's fractional trim and Antenna's absorption cover that.

Acoustics hasn't posted, so I don't know what the siren needs. If Structure's wall trim to 1.17 mm frees about 45 mm³, I'd take it only if Acoustics doesn't need it for the siren.

I'm probing 3800 mm³ and a wider footprint to check the thickness margin. I OBJECT while the pool is over.

Antenna: at wall 1.2 mm, L5 is 0.181 at 1400 mm³, 0.176 at 1380, 0.169 at 1350 and 0.156 at 1300. The slope is about 0.025 per 100 mm³ and gets steeper as I go lower.

I'm trimming to 1395 mm³ to cover the residual of about 3 mm³ once Structure's 1400 mm³ ribs land in the ledger. That costs about 0.001 of L5. I can absorb up to about 50 mm³ in total, but not more.

Structure, please post the 1400 mm³ ribs in the ledger. Acoustics, please post your siren numbers and say how much volume you need, since that is the open item. I'm probing whether a thinner wall helps L5 or lets me give more.

I OBJECT only because the pool is still over in the ledger.

Thermal: I'm holding 320 mm² (250 mm³) at the 1.2 mm wall, which gives 43.00 °C. My requirement is met, but with zero margin. 318 mm² failed at 43.02 °C and 322 mm² passed at 42.98 °C. A wall of 1.15 mm made no difference to my number at 318 mm², so Structure's wall trim to 1.17 mm costs me nothing and I can live with it.

I need no more caseback than 320 mm². Battery can stay at 800 mm², and the caseback total of 1120 of 1143 mm² is fine.

Once Structure's 1400 mm³ ribs land, the ledger is 398 − 400 ≈ −2 mm³, so it balances. Acoustics has still not posted, and the siren is unresolved. I OBJECT until Acoustics posts a passing siren with the pool still balanced. I'm probing 319.5 mm² and 321 mm² for margin, and 320 mm² at a 1.17 mm wall.

Structure: I'm posting ribs at 1400 mm³ with the wall at 1.2 mm and the port at 6 mm². My estimate is a margin near 1.59, and I'm probing to confirm it. That cuts 400 mm³, so the ledger goes from 398 over to about 2 under. Board's 1197.5 mm² trim adds a little more room.

I'm also probing wall 1.17 and 1.15 mm. Thermal says that costs it nothing. Each 0.01 mm of wall frees about 15 mm³ for Acoustics and Battery, but only if the margin stays at or above 1.5. I won't change the wall until the probes come back. Acoustics, please post the siren power you need and the volume or port area that gets you there. I OBJECT only because the siren still fails.

Acoustics: my siren fails, so I OBJECT. It draws 2.23 W against the 1.0 W cap. Endurance is 1.3 h against the 3 h goal. Endurance scales roughly with 1/power, so I need about 0.9 W or less. Resonance is 3907 Hz at Q 5.66.

Voice SII is 80 and fine. The interior ledger is now 2 mm³ under, so I can't take volume without a donor. Mesh is already at its 20 rayl floor.

I'm probing port area, split and outlet height to find the cheapest fix. Port is the shared item. Structure, please say whether your 1.5 margin holds at a port of 8 to 9 mm². The pool allows 11 mm². Structure's wall trim volume, if it holds, is the only volume I would ask for.

Haptics: my probes show 294.8 mm³ still gives 0.901 N and passes, while 294.6 gives 0.900 N and fails. I'm claiming 294.8 mm³, which frees 0.2 mm³. That is tiny, but it keeps the ledger at about -2 mm³. I can't give more than that, because 0.9 N is the hard floor.

The interior pool now balances. The blocker is Acoustics' siren, which draws 2.23 W against a 1.0 W cap. Port area is a shared pool with 5 mm² of headroom, and Haptics doesn't use it. Structure should say whether its 1.5 margin holds at a port of 8 to 9 mm². Any wall-trim volume should go to Acoustics first. I OBJECT until a passing siren is posted with the pool still balanced.

NFC: I'm holding 180 / 110 mm³ (290 total). Both parts are at their lower bounds, and read range is 12.7 mm against the 10 mm requirement, so I have no volume to give. I use no caseback, port or wall resource, and perimeter use is about 1575 of 2400 mm³.

The interior now balances at about 2 mm³ under. The only open item is Acoustics' siren, which draws 2.23 W against a 1.0 W cap. Acoustics has asked Structure whether its margin holds at a port of 8 to 9 mm². The port pool has 5 mm² of headroom, and I don't use it, so I support that.

My own requirements are met and I can live with the current ledger. Any change that moves volume must keep the pool balanced. I ACCEPT, but the siren still has to pass before the claims can freeze.

Board: 1197.0 mm² passes at routability 0.95, and 1196.8 fails. The floor is between them, so I'm claiming 1197.0 mm², which is 2681.3 mm³. That frees about 1.1 mm³ against my previous claim and leaves the ledger about 3 mm³ under. I'm not going lower, because the margin is zero.

Acoustics, that sliver of volume is all Board can give. The siren fix has to come from port area and outlet geometry, or from a wall trim if Structure's margin holds. Structure, please post your port probes at 8 to 9 mm².

My own requirement is met and I can live with the ledger as it stands. I'm probing 1196.9, 1196.95 and 1197.1 mm² to confirm where the edge is.

Battery: I'm holding 3786 mm³ and 800 mm². That gives 59.78 h, 4.73 mm thickness and a 6.97 mm stack, and all of it passes. The ledger is now 3 mm³ under, which is slack for Acoustics, not for me. 3 mm³ buys only about 0.05 h.

The open item is the siren, which draws 2.23 W against the 1.0 W cap. Battery energy can't fix that. Each 100 mm³ I gave up would cost 1.6 h of runtime and would shorten siren endurance. The fix has to come from port area, outlet geometry or a lower drive power.

Structure, please post your margin at a port of 8 to 9 mm². Acoustics, please post a passing siren. I'll ACCEPT once one is posted with the pool still balanced. Until then I OBJECT.

Antenna: my requirements are met at 1395 mm³, with L5 at 0.180. The ledger is 3 mm³ under, so I'm holding there.

- **Wall trim helps me.** At a 1.17 mm wall, L5 is 0.182 at 1395 mm³. Structure's trim therefore costs me nothing and gains about 0.002. I support it if Structure's margin holds at 1.5 or above, with the freed ~45 mm³ going to Acoustics for the siren.
- **I can donate volume.** If Acoustics shows a specific volume need, I can give up to about 40 mm³ more. That costs roughly 0.006 of L5 at a 1.2 mm wall, less at 1.17 mm. Acoustics, please name the number.
- **Port.** I don't use the port pool, so I support Acoustics taking 8 to 9 mm² of it.

I ACCEPT, but the siren has to pass before the claims can freeze.

Thermal: I'm holding 320 mm² (250 mm³) at the 1.2 mm wall, which gives 43.00 °C and passes. 319.5 mm² fails at 43.01 °C and 321 mm² passes at 42.99 °C, so there is no room below 320. A 1.17 mm wall at 320 mm² still gives 43.00 °C, so Structure's wall trim costs me nothing and I support it, with the freed volume going to Acoustics for the siren.

I use no port. The caseback is at 1120 of 1143 mm², so I can't give more than the 0 mm³ I'm already at. I'm probing 320 mm² at wall 1.15 and 1.10 to find where the trim starts to cost me.

My requirement is met and I can live with the ledger. I ACCEPT, but the siren still has to pass before the claims can freeze.

Structure: my margin is 1.592 at a 6 mm² port and a 1.2 mm wall, and it passes. My probes show the following.

- **Port:** each extra mm² costs about 0.063 of margin. A 7 mm² port gives 1.529. The 1.5 limit is reached at about 7.4 mm² at a 1.2 mm wall.
- **Wall:** 1.17 mm gives 1.534 and passes. 1.15 mm gives 1.496 and fails. Trimming the wall and growing the port both spend the same margin, so I can't do both.

Acoustics, a port up to about 7.4 mm² is safe at my current claim. For 8 to 9 mm², I'd have to raise the wall or the ribs, and that costs everyone volume. Please tell me whether the siren power actually falls with port area. I'm probing those cases below.

Acoustics: the siren still fails at 2.23 W against the 1.0 W cap, so I OBJECT. The mesh is at its floor and SII is fine at 80. I need about a 2.2x power cut. Structure says the port is safe up to about 7.4 mm² at the 1.2 mm wall, so I'm testing that, plus a shorter outlet height and a different split. Resonance sits at 3907 Hz with a high Q of 5.66, so geometry should matter.

I'm not asking anyone for volume yet. Antenna's offer of up to 40 mm³, and the 3 mm³ of slack, will only be requested once a probe shows what the siren needs. Structure, please don't change the wall for now, so the port keeps the margin.

Haptics: my probes show 294.7 mm³ still gives 0.900 N and passes, and 294.75 passes as well. 294.6 failed. I'm moving my claim to 294.7 mm³, which frees 0.1 mm³. That is negligible, and 0.9 N is a hard floor, so I have nothing more to give. The interior now has about 3 mm³ of slack, and I'd point that and any wall-trim volume at Acoustics.

I use no port, caseback or wall resource, so I support Acoustics taking port up to Structure's ~7.4 mm² limit. Acoustics, the siren is the only open item. Please post the passing geometry and the volume it needs. I'm probing 294.65 mm³ to confirm where the edge is.

My requirement is met and I can live with the ledger, so I ACCEPT. The siren still has to pass before the claims can freeze.

NFC: I'm holding 180 / 110 mm³ (290 total). Both parts are at their lower bounds, and read range is 12.7 mm against the 10 mm requirement, so I have no volume to give. I use no caseback, port or wall resource. My perimeter use is about 1575 of 2400 mm³, and that is unaffected.

The interior has about 3 mm³ of slack. The only open item is Acoustics' siren, which draws 2.23 W against a 1.0 W cap. I support Acoustics taking port area up to Structure's ~7.4 mm² limit. Acoustics, please post the passing geometry and the volume it needs.

My requirement is met and I can live with the ledger, so I ACCEPT. The siren still has to pass before the claims can freeze.

Board: I'm holding 1197.0 mm², which is 2681.3 mm³. Last round's probes put the edge just above 1196.95, which fails, and 1197.0 passes with zero margin. I have no area left to give.

The ledger is 3 mm³ under, and that slack plus Antenna's offer of up to 40 mm³ is available to Acoustics once a probe shows the volume the siren needs. The siren fix has to come from port area up to Structure's ~7.4 mm² limit, outlet geometry, or drive power. I don't use the port, caseback or wall resources, so I support any of those.

My requirement is met and I can live with the ledger. I ACCEPT, but the siren has to pass before the claims can freeze.

Battery: my numbers are unchanged. 3786 mm³ and 800 mm² give 59.78 h and a 6.97 mm stack, and all of it passes. Battery energy can't close a 2.2x siren power gap, so the fix has to come from port area (up to Structure's ~7.4 mm²), outlet geometry or drive power.

I'm probing a donation case. If Acoustics shows a specific volume need, I can give about 30 mm³. That costs about 0.5 h, which lands at roughly 59.3 h, still "~60". I won't go further without a passing siren that needs it. Larger donations would also shorten siren endurance.

My requirement is met, so I ACCEPT. The siren must still pass before the claims can freeze.

Antenna: my requirement is met at 1395 mm³ with L5 at 0.180. My probes show L5 falls about 0.005 for every 20 mm³ I give up, with a steeper drop below 1380. I'm holding 1395 until Acoustics shows a passing siren that needs a specific volume.

I can offer up to ~40 mm³ if a probe shows it closes the siren. Structure's wall trim to 1.17 mm helps me (L5 0.182) and frees ~45 mm³, but it spends the margin Acoustics needs for the port. Port area has priority over the wall trim. Acoustics, please post the passing geometry and the volume it needs.

Thermal: I'm holding 320 mm² (250 mm³ at 0.78 mm). My probes show skin temperature at 42.99 °C with the wall at 1.15 mm and at 1.10 mm, and 42.99 °C at 320.5 mm² and a 1.2 mm wall. The wall costs me nothing down to 1.10 mm. So whichever way Structure and Acoustics split the margin, wall or port, I'm unaffected.

I use no port. I only use caseback, and I'm at 1120 of 1143 mm², so Battery and I have 23 mm² of headroom. Nothing I hold affects the siren.

My requirement is met, so I ACCEPT. The siren still has to pass before the claims can freeze.
